===== Problem Statement =====
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
problem_statement.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | In this exercise, we want to implement sorting algorithms and choose them based on runtime specific variables.
 2 | 
 3 | ### Part 1: Sorting
 4 | 
 5 | First, we need to implement two sorting algorithms, in this case `MergeSort` and `BubbleSort`.
 6 | 
 7 | **You have the following tasks:**
 8 | 
 9 | 1. [task][Implement Bubble Sort](<testid>1732</testid>)
10 | Implement the method `performSort(List<Date>)` in the class `BubbleSort`. Make sure to follow the Bubble Sort algorithm exactly.
11 | 
12 | 2. [task][Implement Merge Sort](<testid>1730</testid>)
13 | Implement the method `performSort(List<Date>)` in the class `MergeSort`. Make sure to follow the Merge Sort algorithm exactly.
14 | 
15 | ### Part 2: Strategy Pattern
16 | 
17 | We want the application to apply different algorithms for sorting a `List` of `Date` objects.
18 | Use the strategy pattern to select the right sorting algorithm at runtime.
19 | 
20 | **You have the following tasks:**
21 | 
22 | 1. [task][SortStrategy Interface](<testid>1734</testid>,<testid>1738</testid>)
23 | Create a `SortStrategy` interface and adjust the sorting algorithms so that they implement this interface.
24 | 
25 | 2. [task][Context Class](<testid>1733</testid>,<testid>1737</testid>)
26 | Create and implement a `Context` class following the below class diagram
27 | 
28 | 3. [task][Context Policy](<testid>1736</testid>,<testid>1729</testid>,<testid>1739</testid>)
29 | Create and implement a `Policy` class following the below class diagram with a simple configuration mechanism:
30 | 
31 |     1. [task][Select MergeSort](<testid>1731</testid>,<testid>1728</testid>)
32 |     Select `MergeSort` when the List has more than 10 dates.
33 | 
34 |     2. [task][Select BubbleSort](<testid>1735</testid>,<testid>1727</testid>)
35 |     Select `BubbleSort` when the List has less or equal 10 dates.
36 | 
37 | 4. Complete the `Client` class which demonstrates switching between two strategies at runtime.

 1 | package de.tum.cit.aet.sorting;
 2 | 
 3 | import java.util.*;
 4 | 
 5 | public class MergeSort implements SortStrategy {
 6 | 
 7 |     /**
 8 |      * Wrapper method for the real MergeSort algorithm.
 9 |      *
10 |      * @param input the List of Dates to be sorted
11 |      */
12 |     public void performSort(List<Date> input) {
13 |         mergesort(input, 0, input.size() - 1);
14 |     }
15 | 
16 |     /**
17 |      * Recursive merge sort method
18 |      * @oracleIgnore
19 |      */
20 |     private void mergesort(List<Date> input, int low, int high) {
21 |         if (high - low < 1) {
22 |             return;
23 |         }
24 |         int mid = (low + high) / 2;
25 |         mergesort(input, low, mid);
26 |         mergesort(input, mid + 1, high);
27 |         merge(input, low, mid, high);
28 |     }
29 | 
30 |     /**
31 |      * Merge method
32 |      * @oracleIgnore
33 |      */
34 |     private void merge(List<Date> input, int low, int middle, int high) {
35 | 
36 |         Date[] temp = new Date[high - low + 1];
37 |         int leftIndex = low;
38 |         int rightIndex = middle + 1;
39 |         int wholeIndex = 0;
40 |         while (leftIndex <= middle && rightIndex <= high) {
41 |             if (input.get(leftIndex).compareTo(input.get(rightIndex)) <= 0) {
42 |                 temp[wholeIndex] = input.get(leftIndex++);
43 |             }
44 |             else {
45 |                 temp[wholeIndex] = input.get(rightIndex++);
46 |             }
47 |             wholeIndex++;
48 |         }
49 |         if (leftIndex <= middle && rightIndex > high) {
50 |             while (leftIndex <= middle) {
51 |                 temp[wholeIndex++] = input.get(leftIndex++);
52 |             }
53 |         }
54 |         else {
55 |             while (rightIndex <= high) {
56 |                 temp[wholeIndex++] = input.get(rightIndex++);
57 |             }
58 |         }
59 |         for (wholeIndex = 0; wholeIndex < temp.length; wholeIndex++) {
60 |             input.set(wholeIndex + low, temp[wholeIndex]);
61 |         }
62 |     }
63 | }
